objective: Give Faustin's Truth Serum to Deathstalker Zraedus at Beggar's Haunt.

description: Everything is proceeding according to plan, <name>. I want you to give this truth serum to Deathstalker Zraedus and he'll show you how to administer it.... properly.
progress: I hope you have proven yourself of use to our dear friend, Apothecary Faustin.
completion: I knew old Faustin would come up with something good! You were a tremendous help, no doubt.
Now let's get down to business, shall we?
